title: Dinner Lady Fruit Full Apple Peach 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Fruit Full Apple Peach brings together the crisp freshness of orchard Apples with the rich, velvety sweetness of ripe Peaches. The fresh, juicy flavour of Apple delivers a refreshing bite, while the hint of bold, sun-ripened Peach rounds out the blend, creating a deliciously balanced and satisfying vape. Part of the Fruit Full Bar Salts collection, Apple Peach is designed to replicate the punchy, layered flavours found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures a long-lasting, full-bodied taste while maintaining a smooth and satisfying vape experience. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid provides an excellent balance of vapour production and flavour clarity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation delivers a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for use with pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting premium e-liquids that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their commitment to high-quality ingredients and expertly developed blends continues to make them a favourite among vapers.
